provenance.note: Transcribed from results/live_before_after.csv and results/queue_depth_summary.csv, both recomputed from the raw per-request logs in results/demo_evidence.zip rather than from console output. Cost distributions are counted directly from gateway.jsonl in the same archive.
provenance.hardware: NVIDIA Tesla T4, 16 GB, Google Colab
provenance.generator: Locust closed-loop virtual users, seed 42, flood profile
provenance.profile: 50 s total: 10 s baseline, 10-40 s attack, 10 s recovery. 4 legitimate users plus 28 attacker users, 32 total.
provenance.window: Requests started in the 10-40 s attack window. Percentiles are over successful requests only.
provenance.why_this_is_the_primary_result: Four legitimate identities against 28 attacker identities for 30 s is a far more demanding test than the earlier single-attacker smoke run, and it is backed by raw logs rather than transcribed console output.

cost_distribution.note: Counted over every record in the ON arm's gateway.jsonl. This is the measurement that explains the result: cheap_cost_threshold was 512, so both classes were classified cheap and the reserved lane partitioned nothing.
